response.sql: WITH patient_stats AS (SELECT ID, AVG(PIC) as avg_pic, AVG(HGB) / AVG(HCT) as ratio FROM Laboratory GROUP BY ID), overall_avg_ratio AS (SELECT AVG(ratio) as overall_ratio FROM patient_stats WHERE ratio IS NOT NULL), filtered_patients AS (SELECT ps.avg_pic, ps.ratio, oar.overall_ratio FROM patient_stats ps CROSS JOIN overall_avg_ratio oar WHERE ps.ratio IS NOT NULL AND ps.ratio > oar.overall_ratio) SELECT AVG(avg_pic) as avg_of_avg_pic, AVG(ratio) as avg_of_ratios, AVG(ratio - overall_ratio) as avg_excess_ratio FROM filtered_patients
